title: Cedar Lean specification
summary: Lean formalization of Cedar policy evaluation and authorization semantics, including sound policy slicing results.
reuse: Use the pinned Lean specification as the source of Cedar authorization semantics and as a library of proved properties. For the Lean package, retain the checked-in lake-manifest.json, enter cedar-lean and run lake build Cedar with Lean 4.35.0.

contents: Lean authorization semantics; policy slicing definitions and theorems; source tree and build configuration
project_details.setup: Check out the pinned repository revision, retain its lake-manifest.json, then cd cedar-lean and run lake build Cedar with Lean 4.35.0.
